purpose: Ends the build cycle at complete: on the PR branch before the merge, from the stage-keeper's session, Finalise checks the last round's recorded verdicts, the CI run named for the head, the separation audit, Code Nodes and test strength for every touched criterion, then writes complete. It runs nothing but git and never reads a verify report.
responsibilities: find the last round: the newest ReviewVerdict reachable from HEAD whose fbsIds include the spec; its head is H

check, in the interface's order: --ci-run present, a ReviewVerdict for the spec, REVIEW passed at H, after H only the REVIEW: commit adding the verdict for H and TEST: and FINALISE: commits, TEST PASS at H and no FAIL TestVerdict after it, with a FINALISE: merge after H a green --merge-suite record at the newest merge head, test strength at H for every touched criterion, touched criteria cover every live criterion of a spec at inProgress and every criterion changed since the base, Code Nodes for every touched criterion, and the separation audit over the range
write executionStatus complete (or keep verified when every touched criterion is testOnly) and print one line
refuse rcf build mark <fbs-id> complete: complete is written only by Finalise

interfaces.name: rcf build finalise
interfaces.description:
usage: rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> [--merge-suite <file>]
Checks in this order and exits on the first refusal: retired flags (--report, --max-report-age, --mode, --url, --allow-pre-merge: exit 2 "finalise no longer reads a verify report; Finalise writes complete from the recorded REVIEW, TEST and test-strength verdicts (rcf guidance build-cycle)"); tree validation (exit 3); --ci-run absent (exit 4 "ci evidence missing: pass --ci-run <ref>"); no ReviewVerdict for the spec reachable from HEAD (exit 4 "finalise refused: no REVIEW verdict for <fbs-id> on the branch"); REVIEW failed at H (exit 4 "finalise refused: REVIEW at <H7> is <code>/<adequacy>; a failed verdict closes the round"); a spec at notStarted (exit 4 "finalise refused: <fbs-id> is notStarted; the round's DEFINE: marks it inProgress"); any commit after H other than the REVIEW: commit adding the verdict for H and TEST: or FINALISE: commits (exit 4 "finalise refused: REVIEW reopened by <s7> <STAGE>: after the reviewed head <H7>"); TEST verdict missing or FAIL, or a FAIL TestVerdict after H (exit 4 "finalise refused: no TEST verdict at <H7>" / "finalise refused: TEST at <H7> is FAIL" / "finalise refused: TEST at <M7> is FAIL; a failed verdict closes the round"); a FINALISE: merge after H without a green --merge-suite record at the newest merge head M (exit 4 "finalise refused: merge from main after the reviewed head; pass --merge-suite <a green base-suite record at <M7>>" / "finalise refused: base suite recorded at <x7>, merge head is <M7>" / "finalise refused: base suite red at <M7>; the verifier records TEST FAIL at the merge head"); test strength missing, failing or partial (exit 4 "finalise refused: no test-strength record at <H7>" / "finalise refused: test-strength at <H7> fails for <ids>" / "finalise refused: test-strength at <H7> omits <ids>"); touched criteria short (exit 4 "finalise refused: touched criteria omit <ids> changed since <base7>"); a touched criterion with no Code Node (exit 3 "finalise refused: missing Code Node for <ids>"); separation (exit 4 "finalise refused: separation FAIL: <the audit items>"). Success: writes executionStatus complete and prints "finalise: <fbs-id> complete at <head7> (reviewed <H7>, ci <ref>, touched <n> criteria)", exit 0; with a merge from main after H also "[info] finalise: merge from main after the reviewed head; base suite green at <M7> is the suite evidence, ci <ref> on <head7>"; already complete for the same H: "finalise: <fbs-id> complete (unchanged)", no write; already complete at a new H (an amend round): the complete line for the new H, file byte-identical; --ci-run names the passing CI run on HEAD at the time Finalise runs, and the FINALISE: status commit that follows is gated by the pull request's required checks, not by Finalise; spec verified and every touched criterion testOnly: "finalise: <fbs-id> verified (unchanged: touched criteria are testOnly)", no write.

interfaces.name: rcf build mark (complete refused)
interfaces.description:
usage: rcf build mark <fbs-id> notStarted|inProgress
rcf build mark <fbs-id> complete exits 4 with "mark refused: complete is written only by rcf build finalise from the recorded verdicts"; verified stays refused (exit 4) as today.

notes: Replaces the report ingestion of TAC-4148 (src/finalise/index.js:1-7 header, src/finalise/ingest.js loadVerifyReport :326-388, headContained :427-437, builderHandIds :447-465, checkReportProvenance :483-513). Keeps the administrative shape of ADR-4148 and ADR-4151: pre-merge on the PR branch, from the stage-keeper's session, spawning nothing but git.
name: Light Finalise: rcf build finalise writes complete from the recorded REVIEW, TEST and test-strength verdicts of the last round
